articles.model: GPT-6 Astra Medium · Sol source/completeness review
articles.availability_note: Source review: November 24 institutional reports and publication metadata, plus the linked public author manuscript dated September 11, describe an estimated 360-million-solar-mass black hole at a cosmic age around 630 million years. The record concerns quasars, and 40 million years concerns the earlier cosmic epoch. Growth histories are model-dependent. Publisher full text was inaccessible; the public manuscript is not asserted to match the final version exactly. No independent replication or observed birth is claimed.
